algolia.name: Amped Wireless - 1000 mW Wi-Fi Signal Booster - Black
algolia.description: The SB1000 amplifies the signal strength of your certified Wi-Fi device to deliver more Wi-Fi range and performance. The SB1000 replaces the removable antenna on your certified Wi-Fi device to boost the signal by 20x in a 360 radius to eliminate dead zones.
